== Description ==

Sample Plugin does **one thing** and uses `wp-sitemap.xml`.

= What it does =

* First item with a [link](https://example.com/a?b=1&c=2)
* Second item that
  continues on the next line

Second paragraph with <b>raw HTML</b>.

1. Not used.
